source.dataset: Cook et al. 2019, C. elegans hermaphrodite (Nature 571:63-71)

format: neurons sorted by name; chemical and electrical entries are [pre_index, post_index, synapse_count] into neurons. Chemical connections are directed. Electrical couplings are symmetric and listed once, with name(pre) <= name(post) in sort order; self-couplings are kept. Self-connections are kept in both lists.
category_note: category from the data set's own lists in cect.Cells: SENSORY_NEURONS_COOK, INTERNEURONS_COOK, MOTORNEURONS_COOK; 'other' = in none of them. class = trailing digits dropped, then a trailing L or R dropped when the other side exists (derived by neuron_class() in the script, not a field of the data).
